notes.title: Problems with installing Hex Empire are solved!
notes.notes: I finally figured out what caused problems for some people. Everybody should be now able to install the game correctly and start to wreak havoc right away!

notes.title: Problems installing Hex Empire 3 after last update
notes.notes: Some people reported problems installing the game after last update. If you still experience the problem please contact me.

notes.title: Mac OS X Version Released!
notes.notes: Hex Empire 3 is now available on all Steam platforms! I hope you'll enjoy. Please tell me about any problems.

notes.title: Version 0.77.1 released!
notes.notes:
NEW FEATURE - Chellenge - master your strategy on selected map and compete with other players on Leaderboards! It's experimental feature and not yet well tested, please tell me about any problems.

There also many smaller improvements:
- in the map editor you can now draw with biger brush
- radioactive contamination wears off with time
- you can change visual style of any map before you play
And many others...

notes.title: Linux/Steam OS version released!
notes.notes: Enjoy! Mac vesion hopefully will be ready soon.

notes.title: Version 0.76.5 released!
notes.notes:
First of all the scarry bug that sometimes made a battle impossible to finish should be gone now.
Other than that there are improvements to AI and many minor improvements and bug fixes.
